Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: landscape editorial technology image for KATIA.AI, a serious, professional custom AI agency serving business administration, accounting, finance, tax, apps and customer service. This is a conceptual visual, not an actual client application.
Primary request: premium real product photography of a contemporary tablet and phone on a clean deep-navy desk in a refined daylight business workspace.

Their screens display elegant generic minimal business application interfaces composed only of a few understated cards, lines, and shapes with no legible words, numbers, brand names, logos, or metrics. Refined glass and subtle teal material accents in a real architectural interior.
Style/medium: photorealistic premium editorial product photography, tactile materials, believable devices, nuanced reflections, realistic camera depth and daylight.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape; confident simple composition with room around both fully visible devices for responsive cropping.
Lighting/mood: architectural daylight, sophisticated, calm, trustworthy.
Color palette: deep navy, white, blue-gray neutrals, restrained teal with a trace of subdued violet in glass reflections.
Avoid: people, robots, neon, floating circuitry, sci-fi holograms, fantasy, watermark, legible text, letters, numbers, logos, invented metrics, charts with data, crowded props.
